_README: Design spec for the 8 content hubs. Edit values here, then run:  node scripts/build-hubs.mjs   (rewrites only the <head> meta, the fonts <link>, and the :root token block of each web/hub/<slug>/index.html). Add --check to verify without writing, --deck <path> to also sync the Hub Deck artifact. Shared layout + render JS are never touched.

meta.title: AI Implementation — where small-business AI projects stall, and how to get them shipped
meta.description: Most AI projects don't fail — they stall. The nine places a small-business AI rollout breaks between the demo and production, and what to do about each.
meta.ogDescription: Where small-business AI projects stall — failed pilots, hallucinations, no adoption, broken integrations — and how to get them shipped.

tokenNotes.bg: clean daylight — not a dev console
tokenNotes.accent: deep persimmon — the one CTA (white text reads)

ai-implementation.rationale: Audience: non-technical small-business owners mid-rollout, often burned by a vendor. Daylight white + a calm working-green reads plain and finished — the opposite of the console-navy/cyan look of the tools that overpromised. Persimmon spent once, on the teardown CTA.

meta.title: The Care Gap — a philanthropist's briefing on the caregiver workforce crisis
meta.description: 9.7 million direct-care jobs open by 2034 at a median wage under $26,000. The Care Gap is the Mobility Mentor Foundation's brief for funders: the crisis in named numbers, and the four pillars that move them.
meta.ogDescription: A documented care-workforce crisis, an underserved philanthropic space, and impact you can report against an ESG framework. The briefing for foundation officers and impact investors.

tokenNotes.bg: cool report-cover grey — a policy brief, not a folder
tokenNotes.accent: data-red — the crisis figure; used once, loudly

care-gap.rationale: Audience: foundation officers and impact investors. Cool institutional grey + a steady blue + a single data-red reads as a policy brief / annual report, not a cozy manila folder. The red marks the crisis figure, used once.

meta.title: Creative Flow Guitar — a new guitar session every week
meta.description: One guitar session a week, recorded raw — the tone, the room, the take left as it happened. Download the MP3 and the live recording, study it, play along.
meta.ogDescription: A new guitar session every week. Real playing, real feel — MP3s and live recordings you can own, study, and play along with.

tokenNotes.bg: walnut / record-black — an after-dark listening room
tokenNotes.accent: worn label red — used once, loudly

creative-flow-guitar.rationale: A dark walnut listening room after hours. Tube-amp amber is the primary; a worn label-red is the accent. DM Serif Display for liner-note contrast. Built for the vinyl / authentic-sound audience in the research.

meta.title: Home Services — one person for repairs, the yard, the pets, and the house while you're away (Northern California)
meta.description: Small repairs a contractor won't come for, seasonal yard work, pet and property care, and house-sitting while you travel — from one reliable person. Paid, work-trade, or a mix. Northern California.
meta.ogDescription: One person for the house stuff — small repairs, the yard, the pets, and watching the place while you're away. Northern California.

tokenNotes.bg: primed drywall — a clean job, warm white

home-services.rationale: One reliable person for the house stuff, Northern California. Primed-drywall white + worksite slate-blue + safety orange — a service van and a clipboard, not a farmhouse.

meta.title: Mountainwize — purpose coaching for men who got everything right
meta.description: Therapy got you functional. This is the part after. Structured purpose coaching for men over 40, run by someone who has actually been lost, actually lost the money, and actually found the way through.
meta.ogDescription: Purpose coaching for men over 40 who did everything right and still feel the gap. Lived, consequence-earned — not another framework from someone who's never risked anything.

tokenNotes.accent: the route line — used once, on the CTA

mountainwize.rationale: Purpose coaching for men 40+ who did everything right. Cold high-altitude blue-grey (per the hub DESIGN.md: if revisited, go colder), alpine slate-blue primary, a single brick-red route line on the CTA. Zero imagery.

meta.title: Build Watcher — independent owner's representation for construction projects
meta.description: Your architect manages design; your GC manages their margin. Build Watcher manages the budget, schedule, scope and risk for the owner, from feasibility through closeout.
meta.ogDescription: Independent owner's representation for construction projects. Someone watching the build for you — and only you.

tokenNotes.bg: deep cyanotype — a night jobsite, watched
tokenNotes.accent: redline / markup orange — used once, loudly

owners-rep.rationale: Owner’s representative — construction oversight. Deep cyanotype night-jobsite + drafting cyan + redline orange. An instrument panel: precise, watched.

meta.title: Sunflower Acres — a wheelchair-accessible flower farm in Concord, California
meta.description: Step-free into and through the fields. Accessible parking and restrooms, loaner wheelchairs on site, companions free. Come cut your own flowers in Concord, CA.
meta.ogDescription: A wheelchair-accessible flower farm in Concord, California. The same day at the farm, for everyone.

tokenNotes.bg: warm sunlight on a clear day
tokenNotes.ink: rich soil brown-black — high contrast on purpose
tokenNotes.accent: deep seed-head gold — carries white button text; used once, loudly

sunflower-acres.rationale: Wheelchair-accessible flower farm, Concord CA. Warm sunlight ground, deliberately deep soil-brown ink for contrast (low-vision visitors), leaf green + a deep seed-head gold. Accessibility is the brand, so the palette leads with clarity and warmth.

meta.title: Surf Vacations — trip reports, break intel, charter logistics
meta.description: Where the swell is and how to get there. Season timing, honest charter costs, and uncrowded breaks for surfers who plan around the forecast.
meta.ogDescription: Trip reports, break guides, and charter logistics for surfers who plan around forecasts, not calendars.

tokenNotes.bg: cool sea-mist — a tide chart, not a resort

surf-vacations.rationale: Trip reports, break intel, charter logistics for surfers who plan around the forecast. Cool sea-mist ground reads like a tide chart / almanac rather than a resort brochure; ocean teal primary, buoy orange accent.
